poems.title: Sitaron is the first
poems.original_text:
ستاروں سے آگے جہاں اور بھی ہیں
ابھی عشق کے امتحاں اور بھی ہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
Beyond the constellations lies the vast infinite world,
The ordeal of divine love is still far ahead.

poems.title: Flight of the Shaheen
poems.original_text:
تو شاہیں ہے پرواز ہے کام تیرا
ترے سامنے آسماں اور بھی ہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
You are the king falcon (shahin), your work is to join the wings in the eternal sky;
Your boundary is not only this blue sky, there are many more skies ahead.

poems.title: Boundaries of time and place
poems.original_text:
اسی روز و شب میں الجھ کر نہ رہ جا
کہ تیرے زمان و مکاں اور بھی ہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
Don't just be caught in the net of these day and night calculations,
For your soul there is eternal cosmic space and time.

poems.title: A call to young Muslims
poems.original_text:
کبھی اے نوجواں مسلم! تدبر بھی کیا تو نے
وہ کیا گردوں تھا تو جس کا ہے اک ٹوٹا ہوا تارا
poems.bangla_translation:
O young Muslim! Have you ever realized?
You were a lofty space of that dignity, one of whose falling bright stars you are today!

poems.title: Honorable ancestors
poems.original_text:
تجھے اس قوم نے پالا ہے آغوشِ محبت میں
کچل ڈالا تھا جس نے پاؤں میں تاجِ سرِ دارا
poems.bangla_translation:
You have been cherished in the arms of that brave mujahid nation,
The proud crown of world-conquering emperors Darius-Caesars who trampled underfoot.

poems.title: A lost tradition
poems.original_text:
گنوادی ہم نے جو اسلاف سے میراث پائی تھی
ثریا سے زمیں پر آسماں نے ہم کو دے مارا
poems.bangla_translation:
We have lost the inheritance of ideals from our forefathers;
So today the sky from Suraiya Nakshatra has hit us with dust.

poems.title: Life is made up of time
poems.original_text:
عمل سے زندگی بنتی ہے جنت بھی جہنم بھی
یہ خاکی اپنی فطرت میں نہ نوری ہے نہ ناری ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
It is through honest and pure actions that life becomes heaven or hell;
This man made of clay is neither an angel nor a devil in himself.

poems.title: Dil of Mard-e-Mumin
poems.original_text:
ہزار خوف ہو لیکن زباں ہو دل کی رفیق
یہی رہا ہے ازل سے قلندروں کا طریق
poems.bangla_translation:
No matter how many thousand fears and apprehensions come before, the tongue will always be the companion of the heart—
This is the traditional path of self-sacrificing Qalandars from time immemorial.

poems.title: A prayer of liberation
poems.original_text:
یہ ایک سجدہ جسے تو گراں سمجھتا ہے
ہزار سجدے سے دیتا ہے آدمی کو نجات
poems.bangla_translation:
You consider the single Sajdah dedicated to the court of Allah to be very difficult and heavy,
That one prostration frees man from bowing before thousands of Taghut.

poems.title: Ishaq Maidan
poems.original_text:
بے خطر کود پڑا آتشِ نمرود میں عشق
عقل ہے محوِ تماشائے لبِ بام ابھی
poems.bangla_translation:
Ebrahimi Ishaq jumped into Nimrod's fiery pit without hesitation;
And the worldly worldly intelligence is still standing on the edge of the roof watching the joke from afar!

poems.title: Fakir Shan
poems.original_text:
نہ تخت و تاج میں نے لشکر و سپاہ میں ہے
جو بات مردِ قلندر کی بارگاہ میں ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
No throne, no crown, no great army has that opulence—
The spiritual prowess that exists in the Parnakutir of Qalandar, the saint of Allah.

poems.title: The new spring of love
poems.original_text:
دیارِ عشق میں اپنا مقام پیدا کر
نیا زمانہ، نئے صبح و شام پیدا کر
poems.bangla_translation:
Create your exalted status in the horizon of divine love;
Abandon imitation and build a new era, bring in new dawn and dusk.

poems.title: Buy not sell
poems.original_text:
میرا طریق امیری نہیں، فقیری ہے
خودی نہ بیچ، غریبی میں نام پیدا کر
poems.bangla_translation:
My path is not the luxury of a rich man, but the unselfish pursuit of a dervish;
Don't sell your faith and self-esteem, gain divine glory even in poverty.

poems.title: Buland in the eyes
poems.original_text:
نگہ بلند، سخن دلنواز، جاں پُرسوز
یہی ہے رختِ سفر میرِ کارواں کے لیے
poems.bangla_translation:
High vision, heart-touching tender sweet words and soul yearning for Ishke Elahi—
This is the best path for the righteous leader of the caravan of Ummah.

poems.title: Characteristics of Shaheen
poems.original_text:
جھپٹنا، پلٹنا، پلٹ کر جھپٹنا
لہو گرم رکھنے کا ہے اک بہانہ
poems.bangla_translation:
Attacking the enemy, returning and striking again with rapid speed—
A unique technique to keep the holy faith blood in the arteries always warm and fresh.

poems.title: Vulture vs Shaheen
poems.original_text:
پرواز ہے دونوں کی اسی ایک فضا میں
کرگس کا جہاں اور ہے، شاہیں کا جہاں اور
poems.bangla_translation:
Both the vulture and the hawk fly in the same open blue;
But the world of carrion-loving vultures is different, and the world of free-spirited Shaheen is completely different.

poems.title: A change of heart
poems.original_text:
تری دعا سے قضا تو بدل نہیں سکتی
مگر ہے اس سے یہ ممکن کہ تو بدل جائے
poems.bangla_translation:
Mere verbal supplications may not change the course of destiny;
But through sincere prayer, your inner self will be transformed.

poems.title: Masjid-i-Qurtaba (Time and Place)
poems.original_text:
سلسلۂ روز و شب، نقش گرِ حادثات
سلسلۂ روز و شب، اصلِ حیات و ممات
poems.bangla_translation:
This continuous flow of night and day is the epitome of the ever-changing events of the cosmos;
This evolution of day and night is the real secret of life and death in the universe.

poems.title: Masjid-i-Qurtaba (Immortality of Love)
poems.original_text:
تیرا جلال و جمال، مردِ خدا کی دلیل
وہ بھی جلیل و جمیل، تو بھی جلیل و جمیل
poems.bangla_translation:
O Qurtaba Mosque! Your solemnity and beauty are living proofs of a godly pious believer;
He was also great and beautiful, you are also great and beautiful.

poems.title: Blood point and art
poems.original_text:
رنگ ہو یا خشت و سنگ، چنگ ہو یا حرف و صوت
معجزۂ فن کی ہے خونِ جگر سے نمود
poems.bangla_translation:
Be it the color or the brick-stone architecture, be it the jingle of music or the rhyming lines of poetry—
No work of art reaches its miraculous heights, unless it is composed with the pure blood of the heart.

poems.title: Sigh of Tahajjud
poems.original_text:
عطار ہو، رومی ہو، رازی ہو، غزالی ہو
کچھ ہاتھ نہیں آتا بے آہِ سحر گاہی
poems.bangla_translation:
Don't be Fariduddin Attar, Jalaluddin Rumi, Imam Razi or Imam Ghazali;
Nothing is achieved in the spiritual world except the tearful sigh of Tahajjud on the last night.

poems.title: Rights of the poor
poems.original_text:
جس کھیت سے دہقاں کو میسر نہ ہو روزی
اس کھیت کے ہر خوشۂ گندم کو جلا دو
poems.bangla_translation:
The produce of the field cannot provide the subsistence of the destitute peasant—
Burn up every grain of wheat in that absorbing soil.

poems.title: Mustafa'i and Kibria
poems.original_text:
خودی کی جلوتوں میں مصطفائی
خودی کی خلوتوں میں کبریائی
poems.bangla_translation:
The ideals and justice of the beloved Prophet Mustafa ﷺ blossomed in the public career of people;
And in the silent solitude of the night, the Lord's nearness and greatness are gained by meditation on God.

poems.title: This world is for people
poems.original_text:
نہ تو زمیں کے لیے ہے نہ آسماں کے لیے
جہاں ہے تیرے لیے، تو نہیں جہاں کے لیے
poems.bangla_translation:
You are born not only to serve this transitory earth or sky;
The entire universe was created for your caliphate, you were not created for the servitude of the world.

poems.title: Immortality of Ishaq
poems.original_text:
مردِ خدا کا عمل عشق سے صاحبِ فروغ
عشق ہے اصلِ حیات، موت ہے اس پر حرام
poems.bangla_translation:
Every action of a true servant of God is illuminated by the light of divine love;
Divine love is the eternal source of life, death is forbidden to the virtuous seeker of love.

poems.title: Freedom of sight and heart
poems.original_text:
آزادیِ افکار سے ہے ان کی تباہی
رکھتے نہیں جو فکر و تدبر کا سلیقہ
poems.bangla_translation:
Unbounded freedom of thought only brings ruin to them,
Those who do not have the pure consciousness and moral discipline of thinking and deep research.

poems.title: The light of the heart
poems.original_text:
دل بینا بھی کر خدا سے طلب
آنکھ کا نور دل کا نور نہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
Pray with a heart awake and discerning in God's court;
Because the sight of the skin eye alone can never be the spiritual light of the inner soul.

poems.title: The pace and stasis of life
poems.original_text:
ٹھہرتا نہیں کاروانِ وجود
کہ ہر لحظہ ہے تازہ شانِ وجود
poems.bangla_translation:
This cosmic caravan of existence never halts at any one place;
Because every moment the immense glory of God's creation is being revealed in a new way.

poems.title: answer (plea)
poems.original_text:
کیوں زیاں کار بنوں، سود فراموش رہوں
فکرِ فردا نہ کروں، محوِ غمِ دوش رہوں
poems.bangla_translation:
Why should I always suffer and forget my welfare?
Without thinking about the future, why should I be immersed in the pain of the past?

poems.title: Struggle against Abolition
poems.original_text:
صفحۂ دہر سے باطل کو مٹایا کس نے
نوعِ انساں کو غلامی سے چھڑایا کس نے
poems.bangla_translation:
Who wiped out falsehood and falsehood from the earth's surface?
Who freed the entire mankind from the slavery of Taghut?

poems.title: Declaration of Tawheed
poems.original_text:
تھے ہمیں ایک ترے معرکہ آراؤں میں
خشکیوں میں کبھی لڑتے، کبھی دریاؤں میں
poems.bangla_translation:
We were the unselfish soldiers of your banner of truth;
Sometimes I fought in the dry desert, sometimes I risked my life in the waves of the stormy sea.

poems.title: Azan in churches in Europe
poems.original_text:
دی اذانیں کبھی یورپ کے کلیساؤں میں
کبھی افریقہ کے تپتے ہوئے صحراؤں میں
poems.bangla_translation:
Sometimes in the palaces and churches of the Roman Empire of Europe I sounded the call to prayer,
Sometimes I proclaimed the superiority of Allah in the hot desert of Africa.

poems.title: answer (unity)
poems.original_text:
منفعت ایک ہے اس قوم کی نقصان بھی ایک
ایک ہی سب کا نبی، دین بھی، ایمان بھی ایک
poems.bangla_translation:
The gains and losses of this Muslim Ummah are the same;
The Prophet is the same for all, the religion is also the same and the faith is the same for all.

poems.title: Haram and Quran are one
poems.original_text:
حرمِ پاک بھی، اللہ بھی، قرآں بھی ایک
کچھ بڑی بات تھی ہوتے جو مسلمان بھی ایک
poems.bangla_translation:
The Holy Kaaba is one, the great God is one, Al-Quran is also one;
How blessed it would be if all Muslims were united like a leaden wall!

poems.title: Division of the Ummah
poems.original_text:
فرقہ بندی ہے کہیں اور کہیں ذاتیں ہیں
کیا زمانے میں پَنپنے کی یہی باتیں ہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
Some factionalism and factionalism, and some pride of descent;
Is this an example of surviving with respect in the world?

poems.title: Comparison with ancestors
poems.original_text:
تھے تو آبا وہ تمہارے ہی مگر تم کیا ہو
ہاتھ پر ہاتھ دھرے منتظرِ فردا ہو
poems.bangla_translation:
Those brave mujahids must have been your ancestors, but what are you today?
Sitting idly with folded hands just waiting for tomorrow!

poems.title: Heartlessness
poems.original_text:
قلب میں سوز نہیں، روح میں احساس نہیں
کچھ بھی پیغامِ محمدؐ کا تمہیں پاس نہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
There is no spiritual burning in the heart, no spiritual feeling in the soul;
You have no respect for the noble message of Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ!

poems.title: The light of prophetic love
poems.original_text:
قوتِ عشق سے ہر پست کو بالا کر دے
دہر میں اسمِ محمدؐ سے اجالا کر دے
poems.bangla_translation:
Elevate every lowly one to the pinnacle of dignity by the abounding power of divine love;
And make the whole world shine with the light of the blessed name of Muhammad ﷺ.

poems.title: Owning a pen and paper
poems.original_text:
کی محمدؐ سے وفا تو نے تو ہم تیرے ہیں
یہ جہاں چیز ہے کیا لوح و قلم تیرے ہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
If you are loyal and faithful to the beloved Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, then I myself will become yours;
This mortal world is a very insignificant thing, the fate of the iron and pen of the great creation will be yours!

poems.title: Tarana-i-Milli (Muslim World)
poems.original_text:
چین و عرب ہمارا، ہندوستاں ہمارا
مسلم ہیں ہم، وطن ہے سارا جہاں ہمارا
poems.bangla_translation:
China is ours, Arabia is ours, Hindustan is also ours;
We are Muslims, the whole world is our spiritual motherland.

poems.title: Deposit of Tawheed
poems.original_text:
توحید کی امانت سینوں میں ہے ہمارے
آساں نہیں مٹانا نام و نشاں ہمارا
poems.bangla_translation:
The noble sacred deposit of Allah's monotheism is carefully guarded in our bosom;
It is not easy for any force on earth to erase our existence and identity.

poems.title: Guardian of Baitullah
poems.original_text:
دنیا کے بت کدوں میں پہلا وہ گھر خدا کا
ہم اس کے پاسباں ہیں، وہ پاسباں ہمارا
poems.bangla_translation:
Among the idols of the world, the first house of God is the Holy Kaaba;
We are the guardians of that house, and Allah, the owner of the Kaaba, is our eternal protector.

poems.title: Persistent in the face of cancellation
poems.original_text:
باطل سے دبنے والے اے آسماں نہیں ہم
سو بار کر چکا ہے تو امتحاں ہمارا
poems.bangla_translation:
O sky! We are not a nation to bow to a lie;
Witness history, you have seen our steadfastness through extreme trials hundreds of times.

poems.title: Meer Hijaz
poems.original_text:
سالارِ کارواں ہے میرِ حجازؐ اپنا
اس نام سے ہے باقی آرامِ جاں ہمارا
poems.bangla_translation:
The supreme commander of our caravan is the great man of Mecca, Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ;
Even today our hearts have peace and trust in His blessed name.

poems.title: Tulu-e-Islam (Light of the Dawn)
poems.original_text:
دلیلِ صبحِ روشن ہے ستاروں کی تنک تابی
افق سے آفتاب ابھرا، گیا دورِ گراں خوابی
poems.bangla_translation:
The faint glow of the stars clearly bears witness to the dawn's new dawn;
The sun of tawheed has risen on the horizon, the darkness of the long slumber has been dispelled.

poems.title: Global Leadership Lessons
poems.original_text:
سبق پھر پڑھ صداقت کا، عدالت کا، شجاعت کا
لیا جائے گا تجھ سے کام دنیا کی امامت کا
poems.bangla_translation:
Read again and again the ideals of truthfulness, justice and extreme valor;
Because very soon you will be entrusted with the great responsibility of leading the entire human race.

poems.title: The awakening of Muslims in the storm
poems.original_text:
مسلماں کو مسلماں کر دیا طوفانِ مغرب نے
تلاطم ہائے دریا ہی سے ہے گوہر کی سیرابی
poems.bangla_translation:
Western blows and hostile storms have made the sleeping Muslim a true Muslim;
It is in the midst of the conflicting waves of the turbulent sea that the priceless pearl is fully developed.

poems.title: The mystery of life
poems.original_text:
برتر از اندیشۂ سود و زیاں ہے زندگی
ہے کبھی جاں اور کبھی تسلیمِ جاں ہے زندگی
poems.bangla_translation:
Life is grander than the narrow calculation of gain and loss;
Sometimes life is to hold life force, and sometimes to give life unsparingly in the path of truth.

poems.title: Criteria for today and tomorrow
poems.original_text:
تو اسے پیمانۂ امروز و فردا سے نہ ناپ
جاوداں، پیہم دواں، ہر دم جواں ہے زندگی
poems.bangla_translation:
You don't just measure life by the clock of today and tomorrow;
Life is eternal, ever-flowing and resplendent in every moment.

poems.title: Create your own world
poems.original_text:
اپنی دنیا آپ پیدا کر اگر زندوں میں ہے
سِرِّ آدم ہے، ضمیرِ کُن فکاں ہے زندگی
poems.bangla_translation:
If you want to be among the living, then strive to create your own world;
Life is the deep secret of Adam's creation, the secret conscience of the 'Kun Fayakun' of creation.

poems.title: Khizre Rah (Guide)
poems.original_text:
زندگانی کی حقیقت کوہکن کے دل سے پوچھ
جوئے شیر و تیشہ و سنگِ گراں ہے زندگی
poems.bangla_translation:
Ask the heart of the mountain-digging lover;
Flowing rivers of milk, stone-broken ax in hand, and the clash of hard mountains is life.

poems.title: Shama's call
poems.original_text:
پروانے کو چراغ ہے، بلبل کو پھول بس
صدیقؓ کے لیے ہے خدا کا رسولؐ بس
poems.bangla_translation:
A lamp flame is enough for a moth, a flower for a bulbul;
And the satisfaction of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is sufficient for Siddique Akbar Abu Bakr (RA).

poems.title: Constant pursuit
poems.original_text:
چلنے والے نکل گئے ہیں
جو ٹھہرے ذرا، کچل گئے ہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
Those who resolved to move on reached their destination;
And those who stand idle even for a moment, are crushed under the wheels of time.

poems.title: Bachir Doa (Child's Prayer)
poems.original_text:
لب پہ آتی ہے دعا بن کے تمنا میری
زندگی شمع کی صورت ہو خدایا میری
poems.bangla_translation:
The desperate hope of my heart is uttered as a prayer—
O my Lord! May my life shine like a radiant candle.

poems.title: Service to the poor
poems.original_text:
ہو مرا کام غریبوں کی حمایت کرنا
دردمندوں سے، ضعیفوں سے محبت کرنا
poems.bangla_translation:
May my life's vow be to stand by the destitute and the poor,
And to show selfless love to the suffering, helpless and weak people.

poems.title: Temples and mosques
poems.original_text:
سچ کہہ دوں اے برہمن گر تو برا نہ مانے
تیرے صنم کدوں کے بت ہو گئے پرانے
poems.bangla_translation:
O worshiper, if you are not angry, let me reveal the eternal truth—
The earthly idols of your house of worship have become very old and worthless today.

poems.title: Patriotism and Universalism
poems.original_text:
ان تازہ خداؤں میں بڑا سب سے وطن ہے
جو پیرہن اس کا ہے، وہ مذہب کا کفن ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
Among the false gods created by the modern age, the greatest false god is radical geographical nationalism;
The garment with which this nationalism is clothed is essentially the shroud of divine religion.

poems.title: Worldly greed and truth
poems.original_text:
عطا اسلاف کا جذبِ درون پھر کر عطا مجھ کو
بنا دے میرے سینے کو حقیقت کا شبستانِ
poems.bangla_translation:
O Lord! Restore to me the spiritual frenzy of the heart of the ancestral Companions;
Illuminate this bosom of mine with the light of heavenly truth and spirituality.

poems.title: Strong faith and persistent action
poems.original_text:
یقینِ محکم، عملِ پیہم، محبت فاتحِ عالم
جہادِ زندگانی میں ہیں یہ مردوں کی شمشیریں
poems.bangla_translation:
Strong unwavering faith, ceaseless unceasing action and world-conquering divine love—
These are the invincible tools of the believer in the hard jihad field of life.

poems.title: Punishment for weakness
poems.original_text:
تقدیر کے قاضی کا یہ فتویٰ ہے ازل سے
ہے جرمِ ضعیفی کی سزا مرگِ مفاجات
poems.bangla_translation:
This infallible law of the Lord of the Universe is effective from the beginning of creation—
The only punishment for weakness and cowardice is sudden humiliation and certain destruction.

poems.title: Desire to break chains
poems.original_text:
غلامی میں نہ کام آتی ہیں شمشیریں نہ تدبیریں
جو ہو ذوقِ یقیں پیدا تو کٹ جاتی ہیں زنجیریں
poems.bangla_translation:
No sword or diplomatic tricks are of any use when bound in the chains of mental slavery;
But if the spark of pure faith burns in the heart, then hundreds of thousands of chains of slavery are broken and shattered.

poems.title: Me'raj's teaching
poems.original_text:
سبق ملا ہے یہ معراجِ مصطفیٰؐ سے مجھے
کہ عالمِ بشریت کی زد میں ہے گردوں
poems.bangla_translation:
The Holy Master of Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ taught me this eternal lesson—
Even the seven levels of the sky and the universe are reserved for the reach of the pure human soul's victory.

poems.title: A wake up call
poems.original_text:
کھول آنکھ، زمیں دیکھ، فلک دیکھ، فضا دیکھ
مشرق سے ابھرتے ہوئے سورج کو ذرا دیکھ
poems.bangla_translation:
Open your eyes, look at the ground, observe the sky and the cosmic horizon;
Witness the new sun of truth and liberation rising from the eastern sky.

poems.title: The beginning of a new era
poems.original_text:
اٹھ کہ اب بزمِ جہاں کا اور ہی انداز ہے
مشرق و مغرب میں تیرے دور کا آغاز ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
Wake up O believer! The world stage is getting ready in a new way today;
Today is going to be the beginning of your new era in the horizon of East and West.

poems.title: The true nature of death
poems.original_text:
موت کو سمجھے ہیں غافل اختتامِ زندگی
ہے یہ شامِ زندگی، صبحِ دوامِ زندگی
poems.bangla_translation:
Ignorant and heedless persons regard death as the end of life;
But death is only the end of earthly life, which opens the bright dawn of eternal life.

poems.title: Kalandar and Badshah
poems.original_text:
کسے خبر کہ سفینے ڈبو چکی کتنے
فقیہ و صوفی و شاعر کی ناخوش اندیشی
poems.bangla_translation:
Who knows the misguided thinking of narrow-minded religious practitioners, opportunistic Sufis and lazy poets?
How many hundreds of bright streams of the Ummah have been drowned in the bottomless sea and destroyed!

poems.title: Sword of La-Ilahar
poems.original_text:
یہ دور اپنے براہیم کی تلاش میں ہے
صنم کدہ ہے جہاں، لا الٰہ الا اللہ
poems.bangla_translation:
The present age is desperately searching for a new Ibrahim (A.S.);
The whole world today has become an idolatry, its only cure is 'La Ilaha Illallah'.

poems.title: Slavery to modern education
poems.original_text:
گلا تو گھونٹ دیا اہلِ مدرسہ نے ترا
کہاں سے آئے صدا لا الٰہ الا اللہ
poems.bangla_translation:
Modern materialistic schools have stifled your inner voice;
How will the living thunder of 'La Ilaha Illallah' be uttered from your soul now?

poems.title: human dignity
poems.original_text:
آدمیت احترامِ آدم است
باخبر شو از مقامِ آدم است
poems.bangla_translation:
True humanity is to protect the honor and dignity of humanity;
Be aware of the divine position and dignity of man.

poems.title: Petition to the Lord
poems.original_text:
حضورِ حق میں سر افگندہ ہوں میں
خطاکار و گنہ بخشندہ ہوں میں
poems.bangla_translation:
In the holy court of Allah I stand with my head bowed;
I am a heinous criminal and sinner, and You are the Most Forgiving and Merciful Lord.

poems.title: Ishke Mustafa ﷺ
poems.original_text:
نصیبِ من سکوتِ کوئے جاناں
زِ فیضِ عشقِ پاکِ مصطفٰےؐ باد
poems.bangla_translation:
May the quiet manners and tranquility of Priyanbi's holy court be written in my destiny;
May my existence be blessed with the blessing of the holy love of Prophet Mustafa ﷺ.

poems.title: The light of the Quran
poems.original_text:
بہ بندِ صوفی و ملا اسیری
حیات از حکمتِ قرآں نہ گیری
poems.bangla_translation:
You are caught up in the web of narrow-minded Sufi and Kathmolla controversy;
You are not taking life-enhancing benefits from the living wisdom and wisdom of the Qur'an.

poems.title: pain free heart
poems.original_text:
دلِ بے سوز را نالاں نہ بینی
مسلماں را دگر مسلماں نہ بینی
poems.bangla_translation:
No pleading shall see from godly tears and unburnt hearts;
And so you will not find the true Muslim character among most of the so-called Muslims today.

poems.title: Human creativity before God
poems.original_text:
تو شب آفریدی، چراغ آفریدم
سفال آفریدی، ایاغ آفریدم
poems.bangla_translation:
Oh God! You created the dark night, I made a lamp to shine there;
You created the clay, and I made beautiful vases with it.

poems.title: Conversion of desert into Gulshan
poems.original_text:
بیاباں و کہسار و راغ آفریدی
خیاباں و گلزار و باغ آفریدم
poems.bangla_translation:
You made deserts, steep mountains and forests;
And there I composed fruitful and beautiful groves and beautiful gardens.

poems.title: Consultation meeting of Iblis
poems.original_text:
ہے اگر مجھ کو خطر کوئی تو اس امت سے ہے
جس کی خاکستر میں ہے اب تک شرارِ آرزو
poems.bangla_translation:
Iblis said: If I have any fear in the world, it is only for this Muslim Ummah;
Because even in their burnt ashes, the latent spark of renaissance has survived to this day!

poems.title: Ummat's spiritual disease
poems.original_text:
وہ فقر مٹ گیا ہے جو تھا تاجِ سروری
رہ گئی ہے باقی فقط گدائی و نوکری
poems.bangla_translation:
The spiritual fakir who was the crown of world conquest, is lost today;
Today all that remains is begging and mental slavery to others.

poems.title: The expression of selfishness
poems.original_text:
پیکرِ ہستی ز آثارِ خودی است
ہرچہ می بینی ز اسرارِ خودی است
poems.bangla_translation:
This entire cosmic form of existence is the manifestation of self-esteem;
Whatever you are observing is nothing but the hidden mystery of self.

poems.title: Awakening of the soul
poems.original_text:
خویشتن را چوں خودی بیدار کرد
آشکارا عالمِ پندار کرد
poems.bangla_translation:
When Khudi becomes awake and conscious within himself,
Then he transcends the world of thought and reveals the great truth of reality.

poems.title: The hidden world inside man
poems.original_text:
صد جہاں پوشیدہ اندر ذاتِ اوست
غیرِ او پیداست، او اندر نہفت
poems.bangla_translation:
Hundreds of thousands of universes lie latent and hidden in the depths of man's own being;
The outer world is visible, but the real truth is hidden in the depths of the human heart.

poems.title: The bond between the Ummah and the individual
poems.original_text:
فرد قائم ربطِ ملت سے ہے تنہا کچھ نہیں
موج ہے دریا میں اور بیرونِ دریا کچھ نہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
It is through unbreakable ties with the Ummah and the nation that the individual is dignified, alone he is destitute;
Waves have power and existence within the flow of the river, it is non-existent when separated from the river.

poems.title: The ladder of liberation
poems.original_text:
نکتۂ می گویمت روشن چو دُر
تا شناسی امتیازی حرّ و حُر
poems.bangla_translation:
I teach you a pearly truth,
That you may know the glory of the difference between the true free man and the slave.

poems.title: Oriental awakening
poems.original_text:
جہانِ تازہ کی افکارِ تازہ سے ہے نمود
کہ سنگ و خشت سے ہوتے نہیں جہاں پیدا
poems.bangla_translation:
The dawn of a new world is only possible through new ideas and improved philosophy;
A new world of a self-respecting nation is never created by building blocks of bricks and stones.

poems.title: Khudi's ocean and life
poems.original_text:
در جہاں نتواں اگر مردانہ زیست
ہمچو مرداں جان سپردن زندگی است
poems.bangla_translation:
If it is not possible to live like a dignified hero in this dharani,
But to accept martyrdom for the truth with a smile like a hero is the real life.

poems.title: Western hunger for knowledge and soul
poems.original_text:
خرد نے کہہ بھی دیا لا الہ تو کیا حاصل
دل و نگاہ مسلماں نہیں تو کچھ بھی نہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
What good is it if the dry brain utters 'la ilaha' in the mouth?
If the heart and vision are not illuminated with the light of a true believer, all is in vain.

poems.title: Prayer: Desire of the heart
poems.original_text:
یا رب دلِ مسلم کو وہ زندہ تمنا دے
جو روح کو تڑپا دے، جو دل کو گرما دے
poems.bangla_translation:
O my Lord! Give that living longing to the heart of the Muslim,
Which stirs the sleeping soul and fills the heart with the warmth of divine love.

poems.title: Praying to the Lord
poems.original_text:
تو غنی از ہر دو عالم، من فقیر
روزِ محشر عذر ہائے من پذیر
poems.bangla_translation:
O Allah! You are the free owner of both worlds, and I am a destitute fakir;
Accept my errors and mistakes at the request of Priyanvi on the great field of Hashar.

poems.title: Nargis' cry and visionary vision
poems.original_text:
ہزاروں سال نرگس اپنی بے نوری پہ روتی ہے
بڑی مشکل سے ہوتا ہے چمن میں دیدہ ور پیدا
poems.bangla_translation:
For thousands of years the narcissus flower lamented its blindness and lack of brightness;
Then a true seer Prajna appeared in the garden with great difficulty.

poems.title: Consequences of abandoning the Qur'an
poems.original_text:
وہ زمانے میں معزز تھے مسلماں ہو کر
اور تم خوار ہوئے تارکِ قرآں ہو کر
poems.bangla_translation:
They were once respected and foremost in the whole world for being pure Muslims;
And you have gone astray and insulted today because of rejecting the guidance of the Qur'an.

poems.title: Good morning after sadness
poems.original_text:
اگر عثمانیوں پر کوہِ غم ٹوٹا تو کیا غم ہے
کہ خونِ صد ہزار انجم سے ہوتی ہے سحر پیدا
poems.bangla_translation:
What is the fear of the mountain of pain and suffering on the Ottoman Caliphate?
The bright sun of the new dawn is born only after the sacrifice and bloodshed of millions of stars!

poems.title: Star Hunter is young
poems.original_text:
محبت مجھے ان جوانوں سے ہے
ستاروں پہ جو ڈالتے ہیں کمند
poems.bangla_translation:
My deepest love to all those bright and honest young people—
Those who know how to spread the trap of dominance even in the constellations with their lofty goals and pursuits!

poems.title: The believer's vision and destiny change
poems.original_text:
نگاہِ مردِ مومن سے بدل جاتی ہیں تقدیریں
خرد مندوں کو جو مشکل نظر آئے وہ آساں ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
By the blessing of a bright vision of a true believer of God, the destiny of people is changed;
What seems impossible to the ignorant scholar becomes very easy to the believer.

poems.title: The storm of the heart
poems.original_text:
تیرے دریا میں طوفاں کیوں نہیں ہے
خودی تیری مسلماں کیوں نہیں ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
Why is the storm of faith not stirring in the ocean of your existence?
Why your self-respect and self-esteem could not be a full-fledged authentic Muslim?

poems.title: Khudi's secret is La Ilaha
poems.original_text:
خودی کا سرِّ نہاں لا الٰہ الا اللہ
خودی ہے تیغ، فساں لا الٰہ الا اللہ
poems.bangla_translation:
The ultimate secret of human dignity and self-esteem is 'La Ilaha Illallah';
If selfishness is a sharp sword, then 'La ilaha illallah' is the stone to sharpen it.

poems.title: The mystery of the rise and fall of nations
poems.original_text:
آ تجھ کو بتاؤں میں تقدیرِ امم کیا ہے
شمشیر و سناں اول، طاؤس و رباب آخر
poems.bangla_translation:
Come, let me tell you the secret of the rise and fall of nations—
The main forces of early victory are sacrifice and jihad; And the extreme decline occurs when drunk on luxury and music!

poems.title: Religionless politics is life
poems.original_text:
جلالِ پادشاہی ہو کہ جمہوری تماشا ہو
جدا ہو دیں سیاست سے تو رہ جاتی ہے چنگیزی
poems.bangla_translation:
Whether it is the glory of monarchy or the farce of so-called modern democracy—
If the religion of Allah is separated from politics and statecraft, only the barbarism of Genghis Khan remains.

poems.title: Valuable wealth of slaves
poems.original_text:
متاعِ بے بہا ہے درد و سوزِ آرزومندی
مقامِ بندگی دے کر نہ لوں شانِ خداوندی
poems.bangla_translation:
The agony and burning of God's love is a priceless treasure;
I am not willing to accept the entire divine kingdom by abandoning this high place of God's servant and worshiper!

poems.title: Believer of silk and steel
poems.original_text:
ہو حلقۂ یاراں تو بَرِیشم کی طرح نرم
رزمِ حق و باطل ہو تو فولاد ہے مومن
poems.bangla_translation:
A true believer is soft and sweet as silk in the court of friends;
But in the bloody battlefield of truth and falsehood, that believer becomes a steel-hard rock.

poems.title: The Secret of Kun Fayakun
poems.original_text:
تو رازِ کن فکاں ہے اپنی آنکھوں پر عیاں ہو جا
خودی کا رازداں ہو جا، خدا کا ترجماں ہو جا
poems.bangla_translation:
You are the secret of the Lord's 'Kun Fayakun' creation, revealed before your eyes;
Realize the mystery of your self-esteem and soul and become the spokesman of the greatness of God in the world.

poems.title: The etiquette of self-awareness
poems.original_text:
جب عشق سکھاتا ہے آدابِ خود آگاہی
کھلتے ہیں غلاموں پہ اسرارِ شہنشاہی
poems.bangla_translation:
When divine love teaches people the manners of self-respect and self-awareness;
Then the great secret of divine reign was revealed even to the chained common slaves.

poems.title: Prayer without love is a veil
poems.original_text:
شوق ترا اگر نہ ہو میری نماز کا امام
میرا رکوع بھی حجاب، میرا سجود بھی حجاب
poems.bangla_translation:
O Allah! If the longing thirst for your holy love is not the imam of my prayers;
But my bowing is a veil and my long prostration is only an obstacle in the way of union.

poems.title: The heartbeat of molecules and light
poems.original_text:
حقیقت ایک ہے ہر شے کی خاکی ہو کہ نوری ہو
لہو خورشید کا ٹپکے اگر ذرے کا دل چیریں
poems.bangla_translation:
The true reality of every object in the universe is one—whether it is made of clay or made of light;
If you split open the heart of even a tiny grain of sand, the sun's crimson light will overflow from within!

poems.title: Characteristics of living nations
poems.original_text:
نشاں یہی ہے زمانے میں زندہ قوموں کا
کہ صبح و شام بدلتی ہیں ان کی تقدیریں
poems.bangla_translation:
The signs of a living and self-respecting nation in the pages of history are:
In their constant struggle and pursuit, morning and evening, their fortunes keep changing to new horizons.

poems.title: The depth of the infinite ocean
poems.original_text:
خودی وہ بحر ہے جس کا کوئی کنارہ نہیں
تو آبجو اسے سمجھا اگر تو چارہ نہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
The inner self of man is an ocean that has no shores;
If you think of him as a narrow channel, then there is no remedy for your ignorance.

poems.title: The reality of God's Oneness and Existence
poems.original_text:
نہ تھا کچھ تو خدا تھا، کچھ نہ ہوتا تو خدا ہوتا
ڈبویا مجھ کو ہونے نے، نہ ہوتا میں تو کیا ہوتا
poems.bangla_translation:
When there was no creation then there was only God, if there were nothing there would still be God;
It is this mortal pride of mine that has led me astray, how much better it would be if I were not!

poems.title: Tawheed and creation world
poems.original_text:
جب کہ تجھ بن نہیں کوئی موجود
پھر یہ ہنگامہ، اے خدا کیا ہے؟
poems.bangla_translation:
When in the world of truth there is no single eternal being except you,
But my Lord! What is the fuss and noise around this world?

poems.title: Signs of nature
poems.original_text:
سبزہ و گل کہاں سے آئے ہیں؟
ابر کیا چیز ہے، ہوا کیا ہے؟
poems.bangla_translation:
Where did this green nature and fragrant flowers come from?
What are these windy clouds in the sky, and what is this cool gentle breeze—all are the glory of your power!

poems.title: Destruction of Fanafillah and Surat
poems.original_text:
عشرتِ قطرہ ہے دریا میں فنا ہو جانا
درد کا حد سے گزرنا ہے دوا ہو جانا
poems.bangla_translation:
The supreme joy of a single drop of water is to lose oneself in the raging ocean;
When the agony of divine love exceeds the limit, then that pain becomes the supreme medicine of the soul.

poems.title: The tone of truth and behind the scenes
poems.original_text:
محرم نہیں ہے تو ہی نوا ہائے راز کا
یاں ورنہ جو حجاب ہے پردہ ہے ساز کا
poems.bangla_translation:
Maybe you don't have the insight to understand the secret chords.
Otherwise, every gap visible here is a delicate screen of the harp of the Absolute Truth.

poems.title: Munjat and tears of the heart
poems.original_text:
دل ہی تو ہے نہ سنگ و خشت، درد سے بھر نہ آئے کیوں
روئیں گے ہم ہزار بار کوئی ہمیں ستائے کیوں
poems.bangla_translation:
It is a tender heart of flesh and blood, not a piece of stone or brick—but why should it not be inflamed with pain?
We will cry before our Lord a thousand times, why should anyone stop us from that?

poems.title: The hard pursuit of being human
poems.original_text:
بس کہ دشوار ہے ہر کام کا آساں ہونا
آدمی کو بھی میسر نہیں انساں ہونا
poems.bangla_translation:
It is very difficult for every work in the world to be easy and perfect;
Although Adam is a child by birth, he is not destined to become a true human being and Ashraful.

poems.title: The toys and mortality of the world
poems.original_text:
بازیچۂ اطفال ہے دنیا مرے آگے
ہوتا ہے شب و روز تماشا مرے آگے
poems.bangla_translation:
This whole mortal world is but the playthings of senseless children before my vision;
Here, day and night, only pointless temporary pranks are taking place.

poems.title: There is no release of sorrow before death
poems.original_text:
قیدِ حیات و بندِ غم اصل میں دونوں ایک ہیں
موت سے پہلے آدمی غم سے نجات پائے کیوں؟
poems.bangla_translation:
The imprisonment and chain of pain of earthly life are essentially the reverse of the same coin;
How can people get eternal freedom from suffering in this laboratory before the call of death?

poems.title: mirror of the heart
poems.original_text:
یک الف بیش نہیں صیقلِ آیینۂ دل
سینہ گر پاک ہو تو آئینہ بے جوہر ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
There is no greater polish to clean the mirror of the heart than 'Alif' i.e. the Name of One God;
If the bosom is transparent to the light of God's Tawheed, then it becomes a perfect mirror to receive God's light.

poems.title: Humility before God
poems.original_text:
بندگی میں بھی وہ آزادہ و خودبیں ہیں کہ ہم
الٹے پھر آئے درِ کعبہ اگر وا نہ ہوا
poems.bangla_translation:
We are so self-respecting and independent even among slaves that,
I will not touch the court of the creature, if necessary, I will stand at the door of the Kaaba and wait for the mercy of the Lord.

poems.title: The unquenchable lamp of life
poems.original_text:
غمِ ہستی کا اسدؔ کس سے ہو جز مرگ علاج
شمع ہر رنگ میں جلتی ہے سحر ہونے تک
poems.bangla_translation:
O Assad! What will be the relief of the pain of this life's existence except the presence of the Lord and eternal farewell?
As a lamp burns itself every moment until morning and gives light.

poems.title: A thousand wishes and attainments
poems.original_text:
ہزاروں خواہشیں ایسی کہ ہر خواہش پہ دم نکلے
بہت نکلے مرے ارمان لیکن پھر بھی کم نکلے
poems.bangla_translation:
A thousand worldly desires of the human mind are such that in each desire the soul becomes oral;
Many of my sadhas were fulfilled, but to an unsatisfied soul it seemed too little.

poems.title: The taste of Ishke Hakiki
poems.original_text:
عشق سے طبیعت نے زیست کا مزا پایا
درد کی دوا پائی، دردِ لا دوا پایا
poems.bangla_translation:
In the touch of divine love the soul finds the true taste of life;
The ultimate antidote to pain is met, and the gain is the eternal satisfaction of surrendering to the pain of love.

poems.title: The wonderful sweetness of Haq's words
poems.original_text:
دیکھنا تقریر کی لذت کہ جو اس نے کہا
میں نے یہ جانا کہ گویا یہ بھی میرے دل میں ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
Behold the wondrous sweetness of the word of truth, when truth is revealed,
I think this message was already hidden in my pained heart.

poems.title: Freedom from worldly reckoning
poems.original_text:
عشق نے غالبؔ نکما کر دیا
ورنہ ہم بھی آدمی تھے کام کے
poems.bangla_translation:
The passion of God's love freed Ghalib from all the selfish pursuits of the world;
Otherwise, we were people of great work in terms of worldly interests!

poems.title: The Form of Creation and the Supreme Painter
poems.original_text:
نقش فریادی ہے کس کی شوخیِ تحریر کا
کاغذی ہے پیرہن ہر پیکرِ تصویر کا
poems.bangla_translation:
Every form of the world of creation is a witness to the mastery of the form of a great painter?
Each beautiful picture is like a light cloth of paper, crying out to the Lord for mercy.

poems.title: The unseen world and the awakened soul
poems.original_text:
ہے غیبِ غیب جس کو سمجھتے ہیں ہم شہود
ہیں خواب میں ہنوز جو جاگے ہیں خواب میں
poems.bangla_translation:
What we think of as visible reality is actually a small shadow of the great mystery of the invisible;
Those who dream and pretend to wake up in sleep, are basically still immersed in the dream.

poems.title: Ghalib's identity
poems.original_text:
پوچھتے ہیں وہ کہ غالبؔ کون ہے
کوئی بتلاؤ کہ ہم بتلائیں کیا
poems.bangla_translation:
They want to know who this Ghalib really is?
Someone tell them - we will give our own identity!

poems.title: Prophet love and intercession
poems.original_text:
غالبؔ ثنائے خواجہ بہ یزداں گذاشتیم
کاں ذاتِ پاک مرتبہ دانِ محمد است
poems.bangla_translation:
O Ghalib! I leave the full responsibility of blessing and praising the beloved Prophet to Allah Himself.
Because only that holy being knows the exalted position and true status of Mustafa ﷺ.

poems.title: fire of love
poems.original_text:
عشق پر زور نہیں ہے یہ وہ آتش غالبؔ
کہ لگائے نہ لگے اور بجھائے نہ بنے
poems.bangla_translation:
No one can force God's love, it is such a holy fire, O Ghalib—
What cannot be forced, once applied, cannot be removed.

poems.title: A deep thirst of the soul
poems.original_text:
نہ سنو گر برا کہے کوئی
نہ کہو گر برا کرے کوئی
poems.bangla_translation:
Do not listen to anyone who says evil;
And if someone treats you unfairly, do not treat him badly.

poems.title: Immerse yourself in the ocean of kindness
poems.original_text:
زندگانی رہروِ راہِ فنا ہے اے اسدؔ
ہر نفس ہستی سے تا ملکِ عدم اک جادہ ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
O Assad! This earthly life is essentially an eternal journey on the path of decay.
Every breath of existence is an open highway from this transitory world to the eternal hereafter.

poems.title: The taste of Paradise and Ishq
poems.original_text:
ہم کو معلوم ہے جنت کی حقیقت لیکن
دل کے خوش رکھنے کو غالبؔ یہ خیال اچھا ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
We know the real truth of the endless blessings of Paradise;
However, this idea is also excellent for the satisfaction of lovers!

poems.title: Deep thoughts of eternal life
poems.original_text:
تو اور آرائشِ خمِ کاکل
میں اور اندیشۂ ہائے دور و دراز
poems.bangla_translation:
The people of the world are busy only with external appearance and appearance;
And my mind is always engrossed in the far-reaching deep thoughts of eternal life.

poems.title: Heart hemorrhage and pen
poems.original_text:
دردِ دل لکھوں کب تک، جاؤں ان کو دکھلاؤں
انگلیاں فگار اپنی، خامہ خونچکاں اپنا
poems.bangla_translation:
How much to express the hidden cry of the heart? He knows everything to whom I will plead;
My fingers are tired of writing and the tip of the pen is like bloody tears!

poems.title: The self-absorption of the ocean
poems.original_text:
قطرہ اپنا بھی حقیقت میں ہے دریا لیکن
ہم کو تقلیدِ تنک ظرفیِ منصور نہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
In truth, even this small drop of our existence is basically a bottomless ocean;
But we do not believe in the impatience of a narrow vessel like Mansoor Hallaj.

poems.title: Don't touch the creature's door
poems.original_text:
ہر چند کہ ہے حسنِ طلب شیوۂ رنداں
لیکن وہ نہیں آتے، سو ہم ہاتھ اٹھاتے ہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
Although it is part of the lover's custom to beg in elegant tones,
Yet when He doesn't look back, we fold our hands in prayer (or throw up our hands in despair).

poems.title: Transformation of history
poems.original_text:
عمر بھر دیکھا کیے مرنے کی راہ
مر گئے پر، دیکھیے، دکھلائیں کیا
poems.bangla_translation:
I spent my whole life just waiting for death's way.
I finally died, but alas! Go to the Lord's court and show what deeds of your life!

poems.title: Living and dying in love
poems.original_text:
محبت میں نہیں ہے فرق جینے اور مرنے کا
اسی کو دیکھ کر جیتے ہیں جس کافر پہ دم نکلے
poems.bangla_translation:
There is no gap between living and dying in divine love;
Self-sacrifice is the ultimate happiness for him whose life is renewed by a glimpse of nearness.

poems.title: Majnoor's innocence
poems.original_text:
شوق ہر رنگ رقیبِ سر و ساماں نکلا
قیس تصویر کے پردے میں بھی عریاں نکلا
poems.bangla_translation:
Every form of pure love has proved to be the enemy of earthly comforts;
Majnun has also expressed himself in the canvas of the film in a naked state, free from the illusion of the world.
